title: Sima Yi Takes the State; Jiang Wei Marches North
summary: Cao Shuang is promised his life and his estates, surrenders his seals, and is executed with three clans a few days later. Wei is now the Sima family's, and everyone knows it.
In Shu, Jiang Wei begins the campaigns he will pursue for the rest of his life — nine of them, against a state with five times his resources, in fulfilment of a promise to a dead man.
history: Historical. Jiang Wei's campaigns exhausted Shu and are blamed, then and now, for its fall; the novel treats them as loyalty rather than folly, but does not hide the cost.

pins.note: Promised his life, and executed with three clans.
Begins nine campaigns he cannot win.
Rations his armies to keep the state solvent.
